limitations: Source and AI labels are provisional; staff has not verified them.
Most HMDB clips last 1-4 seconds; movie editing, resolution and staging limit school CCTV generalization.
One playful comic embrace plus separate social-contact controls; limited actual peer roughhousing coverage.

Two longer AIRTLab positives use distinct unseen scene numbers/camera-sibling groups but share room/actors with historical development data; scene-level separation does not establish independent environment generalization.
Assistance scenes are caregiver floor-rise demonstrations; no genuine school friend-after-fall source available.
Low-motion positive is brief near-static restraint followed by a punch; no sustained subtle low-motion grappling example verified.
Opaque upstream pretrained model exposure cannot be audited.

coverage.note: Counts describe supplied footage only. Each required difficult stratum needs positive footage; sample counts do not establish CCTV generalization.
